scenes.text: Many color copiers will flat-out refuse to copy a twenty-dollar bill.
scenes.head: COPIERS SAY NO

scenes.text: Look at the back of a newer twenty. See those tiny yellow twenties?
scenes.head: TINY YELLOW 20s

scenes.text: Their zeros form a hidden pattern of five rings. A researcher named it the EURion constellation, back in 2002.
scenes.say: Their zeros form a hidden pattern of five rings. A researcher named it the yoo-ryon constellation, back in two thousand two.
scenes.head: EURION CONSTELLATION

scenes.text: Copiers hunt for it. Photo software uses a different secret system.
scenes.head: TWO SECRET SYSTEMS

scenes.text: And the paper? Not paper. 75% cotton, 25% linen. Heh... you're carrying laundry.
scenes.say: And the paper? Not paper. Seventy-five percent cotton, twenty-five percent linen. Heh... you're carrying laundry.
scenes.head: IT'S NOT PAPER

scenes.text: So... did you ever notice the yellow twenties?
scenes.head: EVER NOTICED?
